svg.title: Open a linked ticket without losing the one you’re reading — SoftTrack web design mockup (#114)
svg.desc: A blocker, sub-ticket or parent opens in an editable modal stacked above the ticket you were reading. Escape closes only the top layer and returns focus to the row that opened it. Depth is capped at two; the URL does not change, and Back closes the modal.
svg.text: Open a linked ticket without losing the one you’re reading
· peek to glance (#113), a modal to answer a question, the page to work (#112)
From ENG-20’s “Blocked by”: ENG-25 opens above it
marking the blocker Done from here

g.text: Jira repeats a column for every value. Group repeated columns into lists, then map
Repeated Jira columns lose all but the last value
Dry run through the real import path
Saved views and shareable filter URLs
Each team names its own columns; every status still belongs to one of the five fixed
Beside the panel, not over it:
“Blocked by” row it came from stays in

svg.text: past that, links open the page

g.text: A link inside the second modal goes to the ticket page
(#112) rather than a third scrim over a second.

svg.text: focus on the row that opened it

svg.text: The modal renders the shared TicketDetailBody from #112. It is stacked in the overlay model board/overlays.ts already uses, so Escape pops one layer. Opened from the panel
or the page, never changing the URL; at depth two, links navigate to the page instead of stacking.
